subject: Workplace Skills
title: Giving Feedback That Sticks
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Giving Feedback That Sticks.

hook.text: A manager saved all feedback for the annual review. By then, the examples were stale and the impact was lost.

buildup.text: Delayed feedback loses context. The best feedback arrives within 24 hours while the situation is still vivid.

discovery.text: Use SBI: Situation (when/where), Behavior (what they did), Impact (what effect it had). Specific beats vague every time.

twist.text: Positive feedback needs the same specificity. 'Good job' is forgettable. 'Your summary convinced the VP' sticks.

climax.text: Give one piece of specific feedback every week — positive or constructive. Regularity normalizes it.

punchline.text: Same day. Same specificity. Positive and constructive.

quiz.question: What makes the SBI feedback model effective?
options: It keeps feedback brief and to the point
Specifying the situation, behavior, and impact makes feedback concrete and actionable
